name: From Wife to Wench
source:
Fate smiles upon you. You, a simple farmboy from a small fantasy town, find yourself married to one of the world’s most famous adventurers! More fortunate still, she agreed to work as your sexy barmaid when you opened your very own tavern!

Of course, you had ulterior motives when you asked your beautiful wife to work as your tavern wench. Debaucherous thoughts of her in flagrante delicto plague your dreams and daylight hours, and you regularly find yourself scurrying to your bedchambers to choke the proverbial chicken to them.

Will you succumb to these dark desires and insist your loving wife fulfill them for you, or will you struggle against the tide and potentially drive your wife into the waiting arms of another anyway?
